title: Trend intel - know why it's rising
hook: Know what's rising before you post.

beats.narration: Thalon watches the topic areas you describe and sweeps platforms for outliers.
Every rising item carries a plain-language reason: relevance, engagement, velocity, freshness.
Generate from a trend in one click, or dismiss it - dismissals teach the engine.
